intended_object: The difference-of-restrictions map in degree 0 of the Mayer–Vietoris sequence. For a Mayer–Vietoris square (X₁ is the "intersection", X₂ and X₃ are the two covering objects) and a sheaf of abelian groups F, it is the map F(X₂) × F(X₃) → F(X₁), (s, t) ↦ s|_{X₁} − t|_{X₁}. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation:
In Mathlib's `GrothendieckTopology.MayerVietorisSquare`, the maps are f₁₂ : X₁ ⟶ X₂ and f₁₃ : X₁ ⟶ X₃, with X₁ playing the role of the intersection and X₄ of the union. The body is (F.map f₁₂.op ∘ fst) − (F.map f₁₃.op ∘ snd) as an additive group homomorphism. That is exactly (s, t) ↦ s|_{X₁} − t|_{X₁}, the standard difference map in the Mayer–Vietoris sequence. Its sign convention is the usual one, and it matches the docstring.

The map uses only the presheaf structure of F, so it could be stated for any presheaf of abelian groups. However, the library is about sheaf cohomology of sheaves of abelian groups, which is the setting where Mayer–Vietoris squares are studied, so restricting to sheaves is not a meaningful loss of generality.

Mathlib has `MayerVietorisSquare.shortComplex`, but that is a short exact sequence of free abelian sheaves, not this concrete map on sections. Mathlib has no direct counterpart.
